contract: Compare delivered packets from advance with pop, advance_ready with pop, and a pump with a sink that retires each feed immediately.
Compare MOV packets in the demux view and the first video track of each Matroska startup and backward-seek capsule. Fold track, PTS, DTS, duration, flags, size and payload.
For the edited forward MOV cases also fold position, time base and encoded trim.
